name: Paid Twice. Key and All.
question: How do you stop a refund agent paying twice when it already has an idempotency key?

title: How to Design a Refund AI Agent That Never Refunds Twice — Why an Idempotency Key Isn't Enough #shorts
end_card: BLUEPRINT + CODE: THE VAULT · link in bio · follow for more · @ai.transition
caption:
ENGINEERING · How would you design a refund AI agent that doesn't refund twice? An idempotency key isn't enough.

A customer emails about a missing parcel, then asks again on chat. Two tickets wake two agent runs. Neither knows about the other. You pay ₹1200 twice.

Why your idempotency key missed it: it catches a double click, the same request sent twice. Run two builds its own request with its own key, so it goes through. And the order page says "not refunded" until the bank settles.

The key catches a repeated request. This was a repeated decision.

3 rules for any AI agent that takes real actions:

1. Key every action on the thing it changes, not the ticket or the run. For a refund, that's the order line.
2. Record every action in your own ledger before you call out, and check the ledger, not the downstream status.
3. Allow one automatic run for any action you can't undo. A second refund goes to a human.

Save this for your next agent design review. Send it to whoever owns your refund flow.

Blueprint + ledger code are in the open vault. Link in bio.
